top_signals.title: Funds Buy Australian Bonds on Signal Rate Hikes Are Nearing End
top_signals.summary: Investors are starting to snap up Australian bonds, betting that the Reserve Bank is nearing the end of its rate-hike cycle after lifting borrowing costs to a 15-year high.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin correction could be near as traders’ unrealized profit hits 21-month high
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin could face a near-term correction as short-term traders' onchain unrealized profit margin has reached its highest level in 21 months, according to CryptoQuant.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: China’s Launches ‘Mini Stimulus’ to Counter Slowdown
top_signals.summary: China's latest economic stimulus package is designed to keep economic growth on target rather than deliver a broad revival, leaving the country's underlying demand weakness largely unaddressed. Bloomberg's Minmin Low breaks down the measures. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
